overall: The AG declined to review five allegations (non-member conduct, generalized deliberation and notice-posting claims) and found no violation on the website-accessibility and zoning-public-input claims. No corrective orders issued.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the town bulletin board is not accessible 24 hours a day and the town website has frequently been inaccessible, so notices were not posted properly.
allegations.key_passage: Without any specific evidence that the website has been unavailable, we find that the Board complied with the law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged non-member individuals engaged in improper email communications about Board matters.
allegations.key_passage: Individuals who are not members of a public body are not subject to the Law's requirements, thus we decline to review allegations one, two, and three.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged non-member individuals met to negotiate a zoning deal outside a Board meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Individuals who are not members of a public body are not subject to the Law's requirements, thus we decline to review allegations one, two, and three.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged two non-member individuals 'fixed' a Town Meeting vote.
allegations.key_passage: Individuals who are not members of a public body are not subject to the Law's requirements, thus we decline to review allegations one, two, and three.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside of a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint fails to specify which meeting the Board may have failed to notice, and when and in what manner the Board may have deliberated outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board improperly posted a meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint does not identify any evidence to the contrary, we decline to review allegations four and five.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board approved a zoning change without public input.
allegations.key_passage: The Board chair therefore has discretion to decide whether or not to permit public comment during a meeting.
